meta_data.base_class: Generates <a specific type of musical scale> in a given key. This is a general music theory tool that generates a specific scale structure (e.g., major, minor, pentatonic, blues) for a given root note (key).

tool_template.name: music_theory.get_<class>_scale
tool_template.description: Generates the <class> scale in a given key.

key.description: The root note or key of the <class> scale.

show_intervals.description: Flag to show the intervals of the <class> scale.

octave_range.description: Defines the range of octaves over which the <class> scale should be generated. Format: [start_octave, end_octave].

enharmonic_preference.description: Specifies whether to represent enharmonically equivalent notes using sharps or flats. Options: 'flats', 'sharps', 'contextual'.

output_as_midi.description: If true, the output notes will be represented as MIDI note numbers (e.g., 60) instead of note names (e.g., 'C4').

output_format.description: Specifies the format in which the <class> scale should be outputted. Options: 'list', 'string', 'dict'.
